answer_1.quote: Automated essay scoring (AES) aims to assess the quality of written essays using natural language processing and machine learning techniques.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated model performance using two standard metrics in AES, namely quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) and the Spearman rank correlation coefficient.

answer_3.quote: We propose LLM-based Comparative Essay Scoring (LCES), a novel framework for zero-shot AES that first collects pairwise comparisons using LLMs and then estimates continuous essay scores.

answer_4.quote: We measure the agreement rate between LLM decisions and human annotations on a subset of evaluation pairs.
answer_4.guideline: The latter focuses on pairs where a clear score difference exists and thus better captures the LLM's ability to detect meaningful distinctions.
